name: New Relic MCP
description: Lets coding agents query New Relic observability data in plain English, check alerts, and analyze logs, errors, and deployments, for on-call and performance engineers.

skills.name: Query With NRQL
skills.description: Executes NRQL queries against NRDB, or converts a plain-English request into NRQL and runs it.

skills.name: Check Alerts And Issues
skills.description: Lists alert policies, conditions, open issues, and alert events, and reports synthetic monitor results and statistics.

skills.name: Analyze Incidents And Deployments
skills.description: Generates alert insights and user-impact reports for an issue and analyzes a deployment's performance impact (OAuth only).

skills.name: Analyze Performance And Logs
skills.description: Analyzes golden metrics, transactions, threads, and application logs to find slow transactions, errors, and anomalous behavior.

skills.name: Find Instrumentation Gaps
skills.description: Checks project files for missing New Relic config, APM agent, Browser agent, and Change Tracking setup.
